headlines.title: Trump orders military to ‘substantially reduce’ joint exercises with South Korea
headlines.description: The president said he has directed the Pentagon to scale down the exercises, citing South Korea’s refusal to join the war in Iran and his “very good” relationship with North Korea’s Kim Jong Un.

headlines.title: Woman jumps to escape Berlin high-rise fire
headlines.description: Dramatic new video shows a woman jumping from the 11th floor of a high-rise and into a firefighter’s arms, as flames shoot out of an apartment window. NBC News’ Daniele Hamamdjian reports.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Woman leaps from 11th-floor ledge into firefighter’s arms as Berlin high-rise burns
headlines.description: As a furious blaze raged inside a high-rise apartment building in Berlin, one woman was rescued by scaling the building’s exterior and taking a terrifying leap more than two stories down to safety.

headlines.title: Former MLB pitcher Tommy John dies at age 83
headlines.description: Tommy John, the longtime Major League baseball pitcher whose name is forever linked to the groundbreaking elbow surgery that saved his career and those of countless others since, has died, officials said Sunday.

headlines.title: Todd Blanche says FBI will continue providing assistance on Nancy Guthrie investigation but doesn’t have any updates
headlines.description: Attorney General Todd Blanche said he doesn’t believe it would be the best course of action for the FBI to take over the investigation into the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie in Arizona

headlines.title: Rep. Ro Khanna calls for ‘Data Center Bill of Rights’ and says the industry needs regulation
headlines.description: The California congressman also laid out how he believes he differs from Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, as both progressives are floated as potential presidential candidates.

headlines.title: Novak Djokovic reveals unspecified health issue after ouster at Cincinnati Open
headlines.description: Tennis star Novak Djokovic alluded to a health condition after an early exit from the Cincinnati Open, in which he lost to 25-year-old Thiago Agustín Tirante in the second round.

headlines.title: 1 killed, 4 others wounded in Lexington, Kentucky, shooting
headlines.description: Three children were among the victims of the Charles Young Park shooting during summer festivities.
